2608.27265.title: SCIT: Testing Causal Cache Carriers in Latent Chain-of-Thought Models
2608.27265.paper_summary: Latent chain-of-thought models move intermediate reasoning from emitted text into continuous states, improving compactness but hiding the causal object. We introduce SCIT, the Suffix Cache Interchange Test, a causal protocol that constructs exact source-recipient counterfactuals, patches declared cache segments, and identifies which transformer object carries the counterfactual computation. SCIT combines sufficiency tests with K/V component splits, hidden-state controls, semantic source controls, decoded validation, and matched corruption. On CODI-GPT2 and a Sim-CoT-style GPT-2 reproduction, counterfactual arithmetic transfers primarily through value-cache suffix trajectories rather than hidden states, keys, reusable answer slots, or single-token triggers. Complete sufficiency-and-necessity evidence for the late-value-suffix mechanism holds for the main CODI-GPT2 checkpoint; the Sim-CoT-style checkpoint shows the same sufficiency and decoded-control pattern but insufficient matched-corruption evidence for a necessity call. Beyond these local arithmetic cells, SCIT reveals carrier-regime shifts: arithmetic-like GPT-2/1B cells preserve latent-tail value/KV transfer, whereas competent 8B and repaired non-arithmetic cells route through prompt-prefix or full-cache K/V; boundary cells receive no mechanism call. SCIT therefore contributes a cache-level diagnostic, a checkpoint-specific GPT-2 arithmetic mechanism, and a competence-gated carrier map rather than a universal latent-tail claim.
2608.27265.paper_summary_zh: 潛在的思考鏈模型將中間推理從輸出文本移至連續狀態，改善了緊湊性但隱藏了因果對象。我們介紹了 SCIT，即後綴快取互換測試，一種構建精確來源-接收者反事實的因果協議，修補已聲明的快取區段，並識別哪個Transformer對象承載反事實計算。SCIT 將充分性測試與 K/V 組件拆分、隱藏狀態控制、語義來源控制、解碼驗證和匹配腐敗結合起來。在 CODI-GPT2 和 Sim-CoT 風格的 GPT-2 再現中，反事實算術主要通過值快取後綴軌跡傳遞，而不是隱藏狀態、鍵、可重用答案槽或單標記觸發器。對於主要的 CODI-GPT2 檢查點，晚值後綴機制的充分性和必要性證據是完整的；Sim-CoT 風格的檢查點顯示出相同的充分性和解碼控制模式，但對於必要性調用則缺乏足夠的匹配腐敗證據。超越這些局部算術單元，SCIT 揭示了載體體制的變化：類算術的 GPT-2/1B 單元保留潛在尾值/KV 傳遞，而能力強的 8B 和修復的非算術單元則通過提示前綴或全快取 K/V 進行路由；邊界單元不接收任何機制調用。因此，SCIT 提供了一個快取級別的診斷、一個檢查點特定的 GPT-2 算術機制，以及一個能力門控的載體地圖，而不是一個普遍的潛在尾聲聲明。
